quote: Consider two extreme value copulas Joe copula and Gumbell copula with generators respectively, phi_1(t) = 1 - (1 - e^{-t})^{1/theta_1} and phi_2(t) = e^{-t^{1/theta_2}} for theta_1, theta_2 in [1, infty]. Therefore psi_2(t) = (- log t)^{theta_2} and psi_2 o phi_1(t) = (- log(1 - (1 - e^{-t})^{1/theta_1}))^{theta_2}. Then from graphic software it can be shown that psi_2 o phi_1(t) satisfies the below property (2) namely, for A with, 1/n <= A <= 1, psi_2 o phi_1(tA) >= A psi_2 o phi_1(t) if theta_2 = 1 and theta_1 > theta_2.
